thesis: Cellebrite DI Ltd. (Nasdaq: CLBT), Israeli digital-forensics software for law enforcement, small-mid cap; files 20-F and 6-K (no 10-Q), US GAAP in USD. Q3 2026 (release 2026-11-12): revenue 149.0M (+18%), ARR 528.5M (+20%), GAAP net income 26.7M (EPS 0.10 diluted), OCF 56.6M, capex 4.8M, FCF 51.8M (34.8% margin), TTM FCF 166.0M (company figure, 30.9% margin), adjusted EBITDA 53.6M. Cash, deposits and securities about 593.3M, no borrowings line. Guidance 2026: revenue 553-558M, ARR 550-560M (14-16%, reaffirmed, below the current 20% pace), adjusted EBITDA 163-166M (raised); Q4 revenue 145-150M. At 11.53 (2026-11-13 close, +5.9% on the day, 52-week 9.58-19.98) market cap is about 2.89B (250.79M shares), net cash about 593M, EV about 2.30B, FCF yield 5.7% of market cap (7.2% of EV), EV/FCF 13.8x. FY2025 SBC was 44.9M (9% of revenue), so FCF after SBC is nearer 120M (about 4%). Trailing P/E about 46x GAAP (stockanalysis; 0.10 quarterly EPS), forward 17.6x (unverified). The market may be discounting the growth reset after the Q2 ARR miss and the CEO change; the evidence that differs is steady 18-20% growth, 30%+ FCF margins and large net cash, but the Q4 ARR guide implies a sharp slowdown.
counterthesis: The price fell about 30% after Q2 (per search summaries, unverified) because ARR missed and full-year guidance was cut; ARR guide of 14-16% growth for 2026 against 20% in Q3 suggests either conservatism or a deceleration, and the stock fell 14% on 11-12 despite a beat before rebounding 5.9%. The Corellium acquisition remains under CFIUS review with possible divestment. A CEO transition (Shiv Ramji replacing Thomas Hogan, per search summaries, unverified) adds execution risk. Revenue depends on government and law-enforcement budgets and a few legal and privacy constraints; GAAP profit is small (net margin about 16% for 2025) with 9% SBC; Forms 144 filed 11-10 and Form 4 on 11-12/13 indicate insider sales or transfers I did not read. Foreign private issuer reporting gives less frequent disclosure and I did not read the 20-F.
invalidation: Thesis fails if ARR growth drops below about 12%, FCF margin falls under 25%, the CFIUS review forces a Corellium divestment on poor terms, or large insider selling and customer budget cuts follow.
